item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02095","case1_error":"Uses 8/12 instead of Jill’s capacity divided by Jack’s current apples, 24/8.","case2_error":"Adds flame duration to the stated firing interval, incorrectly changing the cycle from 15 seconds to 20 seconds.","reason":"Case 1 forms the wrong capacity ratio; case 2 double-counts duration within a firing interval.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02096","case1_error":"Evaluates the correct sum 57 + 190 + 152 as 309 instead of 399.","case2_error":"Subtracts two unavailable nights as two homework hours and excludes weekend nights from the available nights.","reason":"Case 1 is numerical evaluation error; case 2 incorrectly models both remaining workload and available time.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02097","case1_error":"Uses the first day’s total flowers, 50, as its tulip count instead of 30, double-counting those roses.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correct sum 5 + 20 + 18 as 41 instead of 43.","reason":"Case 1 substitutes the wrong category count into the total; case 2 incorrectly evaluates a correctly written sum.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02098","case1_error":"Evaluates 57 + 190 + 152 as 309 instead of 399.","case2_error":"Treats the $2 price for five juice cans as the price of each can.","reason":"Case 1 is arithmetic evaluation error; case 2 misinterprets a bundle price as a unit price.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02099","case1_error":"Uses 12 birds per snake instead of the stated 3, applying the beetle-per-bird rate at the wrong step.","case2_error":"Subtracts stored sections from the original 40 instead of the remaining 30, failing to deduct the gift.","reason":"Case 1 substitutes a rate from the wrong feeding relationship; case 2 uses an outdated total after a removal.","judgment":"different"}]}
